description: Shared expression test vectors. TS: shared/src/expr.test.ts · Go: agent/internal/expr/expr_test.go. Positions are code-point indexes. Messages are not compared. Section 'containers': resolveContainer() (env + mount paths of one container in dependency order, E_CYCLE). Field 'file' = FileDef content with render 'expressions' (multi-line; secrets allowed). Context 'auto-host': self.host / site.edge.host null = auto host not known yet (E_NULL at the path). Context 'site-peers' (§21 #88): containers.<containerSlug>.host = the DNS name (network alias) on the site network, containers.<containerSlug>.port.<portName> = the container's INTERNAL port; container.* stays SELF. Section §21 #99: field 'devtool' (dev-tool presets: roots var, secret, site, self, deployment, containers; secrets allowed) is the only field where containers.<containerSlug>.env.<NAME> (another container's FINAL env value; ctx containers[slug].env, error = re-raised at the reference) is allowed — every other field → E_NOT_ALLOWED.
